primitives.name: Placeholder Verification Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: Grep for the literal markers: `grep -rniE 'lorem ipsum|REMOVE_THIS|blank-app-v1' app/src/`, and scan for any remaining `<...>` placeholder tokens in quoted strings.
primitives.assumptions: All placeholder tokens must be absent from source code prior to deployment.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Any presence of placeholders results in immediate gate failure.

layer2.mapping: The grep-based search function is isomorphic to a logical conjunction over all file paths and content, returning true iff no placeholders exist.
layer2.telemetry: Boolean outcome of grep command execution

primitives.name: Animation Mode Compliance
primitives.verbatim_quote: An eyebrow is a small uppercase/mono kicker sitting DIRECTLY above the section's display headline in the same column; nothing else counts.
primitives.assumptions: Eyebrows are strictly defined by their spatial and typographic constraints.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs if eyebrow definition is violated or missing entirely.

layer2.mapping: Eyebrow kernel derives from layout and typography rules applied to section headers, forming a derived constraint space for visual consistency.
layer2.telemetry: Spatial alignment and font property validation

primitives.name: Mechanical Gate Completion
primitives.verbatim_quote: Mechanical gate (pre-deploy, code-level) Check each item; fix every hit before deploying.
primitives.assumptions: Each item in the mechanical gate must pass before deployment.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Deployment halts upon first failing item.

layer2.mapping: Each mechanical gate item corresponds to a boolean predicate over source code, forming a conjunction that defines successful deployment readiness.
layer2.telemetry: Aggregate pass/fail status of all mechanical checks
